en.headline: Yellow fire danger warning in force as weekend stays dry and hot
en.dek: The government said the fire risk is high today and urged hikers to stay alert, as the Observatory forecast sunny weather with urban highs around 32 degrees.
body: A yellow fire danger warning is in force today, the government said, meaning the risk of fire is high. People were urged to prevent fires from breaking out, and hikers were told to stay vigilant.
The warning was issued at 6.02am on Saturday. Dry, fine weather under an anticyclone aloft has raised countryside fire risk after a stretch of hot, rain-free days.

The Hong Kong Observatory forecast a sunny Saturday, dry and hot during the day, with urban temperatures of about 27 to 32 degrees and east to northeast winds of force 3 to 4. Similar heat is expected on Sunday, with isolated showers later in the day.

Country-park visitors were advised not to light fires outside designated barbecue sites and to put out cigarettes completely. The Observatory has also reminded the public that hot weather can affect health and to drink more water.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 郊遊人士須小心
zh.dek: 當局指今日火警風險高，呼籲市民小心防火；天文台預料天晴乾燥炎熱，市區最高約32度。
body: 政府公布，今日發出黃色火災危險警告，火警風險高，市民應小心防火，郊遊人士亦應提高警覺，防止山火。
警告於今早6時02分發出。高空反氣旋令本港持續天晴乾燥，連日炎熱少雨，郊野火災風險上升。
香港天文台預料今日天晴，日間乾燥及炎熱，市區氣溫約27至32度，吹和緩東至東北風。明日同樣炎熱，稍後局部地區或有驟雨。
當局提醒到郊野公園的市民，不要在指定燒烤場地以外生火，煙蒂須徹底弄熄。天文台亦提醒天氣炎熱可能影響健康，市民應多補充水分。
